# Ecosystem cluster labels for neighbour-labels.txt's fifteen queries: a pre-committed
# ecosystem label, written before any scoring change and before re-reading scores, the same
# discipline neighbour-labels.txt itself got. This file is committed in its own commit,
# one commit ahead of any pkg/recall change and ahead of the TestNeighbourDocumentFrequency
# re-run that reads it — the ordering is checkable in git history, not asserted in prose.
#
# Mechanical rule, applied in order, first match wins, over the query text alone:
#   1. spring     — query contains "Spring" (any case), or "Maven", or "Hibernate"/"JPA".
#                    This is not a fresh derivation: it is the already-
#                    disclosed "wide" boundary (6 of 15), fixed here as a
#                    committed artifact instead of being re-derived or re-argued each time.
#   2. A single other literally-named technology (keycloak, kafka, docker, liquibase,
#      react, storybook).
#   3. unclustered — no vault-stack keyword names a cluster mechanically. Flagged for a
#      human override rather than guessed.
#
# Two borderline calls, disclosed rather than silently resolved:
#   - "Storybook accessibility addon for component checks": this vault's Storybook notes
#     carry stack:[storybook, react], so it's arguably `react`. Kept as its own `storybook`
#     cluster because "the Storybook family" is always treated as a
#     distinct, named case (the one a floor change must not break) — folding it into
#     `react` would blur that comparison. Flag for override if wrong.
#   - "Liquibase rollback strategy for a failed migration": this vault's Liquibase notes
#     carry spring-boot in their stack too, but `liquibase` stays its own singleton rather
#     than widening the already-fixed Spring boundary (Spring + Maven +
#     Hibernate/JPA, exactly).
#   - "Running a local embedding model for code search" and "Domain events in a hexagonal
#     architecture": no ecosystem keyword in this vault's known stack vocabulary appears in
#     the query text. Left `unclustered` rather than guessed.
#
# Format: a Q: line (verbatim from neighbour-labels.txt) followed by an Ecosystem: line.
# Blank lines and # are ignored.
